title: Besicovitch-Federer trichotomy for almost every linear map (Mattila 18.9)
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ, k := m + 1, Hᵏ := μHE[k], let E ⊆ ℝ^N be σ-compact with Hᵏ(E) < ∞, and let δ > 0. For v = (v₁, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^k let L_v(x) := (⟨v₁,x⟩, …, ⟨v_k,x⟩), let X_v(a,r,s) := {x : |x − a| < r, |L_v(x − a)| < s|x − a|}, and let ν_v := (L_v)_#(Hᵏ⌞E), a finite Borel measure on ℝᵏ. Then for Lebesgue-a.e. v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k and Hᵏ-a.e. a ∈ E, at least one of the following holds. (T1) For every η > 0 there is s ∈ (0,1) with Hᵏ(E ∩ X_v(a,r,s)) ≤ η(rs)ᵏ for all r ∈ (0,δ). (T2) The upper k-density of ν_v at L_va is infinite (dimensionalUpperDensity ν_v k univ (L_v a) = ∞). (T3) Some x ∈ E with x ≠ a and |x − a| < δ has L_vx = L_va.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ), IsSigmaCompact E → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) E < ∞ → 0 < δ → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N)), ∀ᵐ a ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η * (r * s) ^ (m + 1))) ∨ dimensionalUpperDensity (Measure.map (fun x : Eucl N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1))) ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E)).toOuterMeasure ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) univ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) a) : Eucl (m + 1)) = ⊤ ∨ ∃ x ∈ E, x ≠ a ∧ dist x a < δ ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1)) = (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) a) : Eucl (m + 1))
